build_input: Approved build surface allowed main.js, Engine.js, canvas/entity/audio/css/index files; actual changes stayed in main.js, Engine.js, Bullet.js, Explosion.js, audio.js, game.css, plus new thread files.
No gameplay, scoring, wave model, level data, or stack changes were made.
bottlenecks_found: update() calls updateRunHud() every frame; previous implementation wrote level/onion/wave textContent and wave bar transform every frame even when unchanged.

draw() rebuilt outside terrain grid, arena floor draw path, arena walls, gates, corners, gradients, shadows, clips, and gate path geometry every frame. Arena floor had a cache, but the rest of the static scene did not.
Dynamic draw still intentionally includes queued onion previews, speed dot, onions, player, bullets, explosions, and flash.

Expensive dynamic effects identified: speed dot shadowBlur, bullet trail arcs, bullet shadowBlur, explosion radial gradients, explosion shadowBlur, explosion spark path loops, arena clip around dynamic scene.
Audio SFX for shot, bounce, and onion death reset currentTime on a single audio element for frequent events, which can interrupt decoding/playback and cause jank under load.
CSS #game-wrap used filter: drop-shadow around the canvas, a potential compositing cost during full-canvas updates.
implementation_summary: Added dirty HUD rendering with last rendered level/onions/wave/wave bar state, so DOM textContent/style writes only occur when values change or forced.

Added static render layer cache in main.js for outside terrain, grid, arena floor, arena walls, gates, and corners. Cache key includes world size, level, arena points/gates, background size, and render asset keys; invalidated on resize, reset/level load, and post asset load.
Changed draw() order to cached static layer first, then queued onion previews, clipped dynamic speed dot/onions/player/bullets/explosions, then flash.
Added optional ?perf=1 profiler via Engine frameObserver and main.js overlay/console snapshot. Normal mode does not create a profiler or overlay.

Added ?perf=1 diagnostic visual downgrades: bullet trail disabled, bullet shadowBlur disabled, explosion spark count reduced to 35%, explosion shadowBlur disabled, CSS canvas wrapper drop-shadow disabled.
Added small SFX pools for shot, bounce, and onion death to avoid repeated currentTime reset on one hot audio element.
validations_run: Chrome headless CDP normal mode at http://127.0.0.1:4173/
Chrome headless CDP perf mode at http://127.0.0.1:4173/?perf=1
PHPMD not applicable: no PHP files, no phpmd binary, no composer/phpmd config found
manual_tests: Automated browser smoke drove loading Play, movement key, shooting key, and live gameplay loop in normal mode and perf mode.
Normal mode evidence: perfMode=false, hasProfiler=false, hasOverlay=false, canvas 766x351, buffer 766x351, no Runtime exceptions.
Perf mode evidence: perfMode=true, hasProfiler=true, hasOverlay=true, overlay present, canvas 766x351, buffer 766x351, no Runtime exceptions.
Perf snapshot after input: avg FPS 58.96, avg frame 16.96ms, avg work 0.21ms, p95 16.70ms, p99 16.80ms, slow >20ms 1, slow >33ms 1, active onions 1, bullets 4, explosions 0, DPR 1.00.

Full human checklist still needs hands-on confirmation for onion death, speed dot pickup, wave completion, game over, and continue because those outcomes are stochastic/interaction-dependent in headless smoke.
known_risks: Static walls/gates are now part of the cached base layer and drawn before clipped dynamic entities per task direction; normal gameplay is unchanged, but exact wall-over-sprite edge overlap may differ visually at arena boundaries.

Static cache key uses rounded arena/gate coordinates and asset src keys; if future code animates arena geometry at runtime, cache invalidation would need revisiting. Current strategic direction rejects runtime arena rotation.
SFX pooling permits overlapping shot/bounce/death instances; this reduces reset jank but may make stacked SFX more audible during dense events.
Before/after profiler comparison is unavailable because the pre-patch build had no profiler and no pre-change capture was recorded in this run.
deferred_items: No WebAudio rewrite; HTMLAudio pooling is the smallest mitigation for observed hot SFX reset pattern.
No throttling of onlineService update/writeStats was done because that would touch service behavior outside requested priorities.
No change to speed dot shadowBlur in perf mode; it remains a dynamic diagnostic candidate if further measurements show it dominates.
rollback_notes: Revert main.js to remove HUD dirty state, staticRenderLayer, profiler, and perf options.
Revert Engine.js frameObserver constructor option and loop metrics call.
Revert Bullet.js and Explosion.js perf option reads to restore visual code path only.
Revert audio.js SFX pools to single-element currentTime reset behavior.
Revert css/game.css perf-mode filter and overlay rules.
Remove PI-012 thread files if abandoning the task thread.
